schema_note: Neutral input for a repository receipt. Public-repository CI measurements only; no billing figures, no private-repository data. Aggregated counts do not expire with Actions run retention; run ids are kept as secondary pointers.
measured_by: read-only gh REST GET calls (about 587 by the measuring agent's own tally) plus independent recomputation of the Oct 1-2 cells by the coordinator; the agent's and the coordinator's Oct 1-2 cells were identical
caps_and_partitions: Filtered run queries cap at 1,000 results (GitHub changelog 2026-09-25). Days over the cap were split into UTC 6-hour created windows; the per-day sum equals the endpoint total_count and no partition reached 1,000.

push_runs_to_main.note: Push concurrency groups are per run id, so push runs are never cancelled by newer pushes; none of the 689 push runs was cancelled except one Validate run.

cancelled_run_supersession.rule: a cancelled run X is superseded if a run Y with the same workflow, head branch and event was created in (X.created_at, X.updated_at]
cancelled_run_supersession.inference: Validate's pull_request types include edited (validate.yml:9) and Adoption uses the default types, which fits 241 same-SHA supersessions against 2; the runs API does not expose the PR action type, so the link is an inference.

reruns_and_flake_proxies.limit: a re-run overwrites a run's conclusion, so re-run clearances are not visible in conclusion counts

other_workflows.population: security-scan 71 failures (66 pull_request, 5 push), dependency-review 4, native-token-e2e 1; 48 of the security-scan pull_request failures fell on 2026-09-30

failure_anatomy_non_cancelled.timeouts: none: timed_out is 0 in every cell and no failing job had a cancelled step; maximum failing Validate job 1,787 s against the 2,400 s limit (validate.yml:31) and 2,302 s for validate-macos against 3,600 s (adoption-bootstrap.yml:610)

validate_macos_step_medians_seconds.sample: 12 most recent successful pull_request Adoption runs, run ids 37062901624 to 37085568588, created 2026-10-02T20:48Z to 2026-10-03T01:18Z
validate_macos_step_medians_seconds.share: the full-suite step is 84% of the median job; the two test steps together are 90%

macos_unique_failures.method: pull_request head SHAs paired across the Linux validate run (workflow Validate published evidence) and the macOS run (Adoption bootstrap smoke); run-level conclusions, with job-level checks for each failure and the 30-day log artifact for test names; cross-checked on two endpoints (identical 1,025-SHA matrices)

failing_tests_for_15_of_the_30.failing: tests.test_runtime_worker_openhands: OpenHandsDispatchTests x4, OpenHandsUpstreamAdapterTests x1, OpenHandsReceiptTests x1 (2 failures, 4 errors)

tests.test_runtime_worker_openhands_resolver (ResolverRunTests x15, ResolverResultTests x8, PatchValidatorTests x3, ResolverHostTests x2) and tests.test_codex_lane.InterruptionTests x1 (17 failures, 12 errors)
tests.test_child_usage_suite.ChildUsageNodeSuite.test_node_suite_passes x1; tests.test_currency_due: DetailsCommandTests x3, IncompleteSkillCheckTests x1, DueFileTests x1

tests.test_new_wsl_client_config.CodexMergeTests: test_a_conflict_keeps_the_files_value_shows_both_and_the_step_says_so and test_the_message_names_the_app_server_daemon_and_how_to_stop_it (tests added by the PR itself)

macos_unique_failures.limits: failing test names were read for 16 runs covering 15 distinct head SHAs plus one duplicate case; the other 15 macOS-only SHAs were not itemized; the 146 both-cancelled SHAs were not examined at job level; whether a failure is real or flaky cannot be read from step names

caches.workflow_defined_cache: actions/cache at adoption-bootstrap.yml:306-310 only (the embed-model cache); the CodeQL overlay caches come from the dynamic CodeQL workflow (inference)

push_versus_pull_request_duplication.finding: jobs and steps are identical on both sides except event conditions; push has osv-sarif-upload, zizmor-online and zizmor-sarif-upload (security-scan) that pull_request lacks; pull_request has sota-sources (validate) and the changes job (adoption) that push lacks

limitations: Counts are run-level unless stated; a re-run overwrites a run's conclusion.
Timeouts among the 712 cancelled runs were not classified; 40 cancelled runs have no superseding run.
The by-prefix artifact table covers 97% of artifacts.
Linux sample runs for supply-chain and action-compatibility date from 2026-09-22 to 09-26 (no later success runs).
Evidence class: measured via gh read-only on 2026-10-03 (platform records, independent observation), not an upstream test.
